purpose: Give agents a low-resource, deterministic path to repository code search without assuming one provider is installed, free, private, or indexed.

directories.purpose: Provider, workflow, artifact, validation, fixture, and schema authority.
Read-only provider selection, readiness reporting, and query execution wrappers.
Scoped procedure for agents choosing and using code search.

knownTraps: gh search code uses GitHub's legacy API-backed code search and is not the newer web Blackbird engine.
A GitHub-hosted repository is not automatically proven searchable; probe actual search readiness.
An empty result is not proof that an index is complete or fresh.
Sourcegraph Code Search is not a permanent free private-code default in current official documentation; require plan and endpoint verification.
Sourcegraph is an external code-processing boundary unless self-hosted; never select it for private code without explicit approval.
Zoekt local indexing consumes local CPU, disk, and memory; low resource use is a measurement question, not an assumption.
Zoekt Termux support is unverified by this harness; do not advertise it from generic Go portability alone.
Never print Sourcegraph tokens or use src search -get-curl because that can expose an access token.
